scripts.test: npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm run test:quality
scripts.kill: lsof -ti tcp:3000 -i tcp:3001 -i tcp:4173 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill
scripts.quality:lighthouse: npm run build --prefix frontend -- --sourcemap && node scripts/run-lighthouse.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run check:declarations && tsc -p jsconfig.json && tsc -p shared/jsconfig.json && tsc -p backend/jsconfig.json && tsc -p frontend/jsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.declarations.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
